name: @activepieces/piece-simpliroute
description: Connect with SimpliRoute, the last-mile delivery optimization platform. Manage clients, vehicles, visits, routes, and optimize your delivery operations.

auth.description: Your SimpliRoute API token. You can find this in your SimpliRoute account settings under API section.

get_me.name: get_me
get_me.description: Returns account information of the authenticated user via API token.

aiMetadata.description: Return the account/profile of the user owning the API token. Read-only and idempotent; takes no input. Use to confirm credentials or discover the current account context before other operations.

get_clients.name: get_clients
get_clients.description: Retrieves the list of clients associated with the account. Can filter by client key.

key.description: Unique client key to filter results.

aiMetadata.description: Look up account clients, filtered to the given unique client key. Use to find a client and its stored details (id, address, coordinates, contacts) before creating visits or routes. Read-only and idempotent.

create_clients.name: create_clients
create_clients.description: Create one or multiple new clients in the account.

clients.description: Array of client objects to create.

key.description: External identifier or unique key for the client.

title.description: Name or title of the client.

aiMetadata.description: Add one or many client (delivery destination) records, each with title, address, coordinates, time windows and contact details, in a single call. Use when registering new clients to later schedule visits against; not idempotent, so each call inserts new records even if a similar client exists.

bulk_delete_clients.name: bulk_delete_clients
bulk_delete_clients.description: Delete multiple clients in a single call.

ids.description: List of client IDs to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently remove several clients at once by passing a list of their numeric client IDs. Use for batch cleanup rather than deleting one at a time; destructive and irreversible. Re-running with already-deleted IDs has no further effect.

create_client_property.name: create_client_property
create_client_property.description: Create a new custom attribute for clients.

label.description: Label of the new custom property.

type.description: Property type (str, int, float or bool).

aiMetadata.description: Define a new custom property (str, int, float or bool) on the client schema so subsequent client records can store that attribute. Use when an attribute you need does not yet exist on clients; not idempotent (each call adds another property definition).

get_vehicles.name: get_vehicles
get_vehicles.description: Retrieve the list of vehicles registered in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List all vehicles registered in the account. Read-only and idempotent; takes no input. Use to discover vehicle IDs or check the fleet before creating, fetching, or deleting a specific vehicle.

create_vehicle.name: create_vehicle
create_vehicle.description: Register a new vehicle in the account.

capacity.description: The maximum capacity of the vehicle.

default_driver.description: The assigned driver ID or null if not assigned.

location_start_address.description: The starting address of the vehicle.

location_start_latitude.description: The latitude of the starting location.

location_start_longitude.description: The longitude of the starting location.

location_end_address.description: The ending address of the vehicle.

location_end_latitude.description: The latitude of the ending location.

location_end_longitude.description: The longitude of the ending location.

skills.description: a list of skill IDs (JSON format [1, 2]).

shift_start.description: Start time of the vehicle shift.

shift_end.description: End time of the vehicle shift.

reference_id.description: External reference ID of the vehicle.

license_plate.description: License plate or registration of the vehicle.

max_visit.description: Maximum number of visits that the vehicle can perform.

aiMetadata.description: Register a new vehicle, requiring name, capacity, and start/end location coordinates. Not idempotent: each call creates another vehicle, so avoid retrying. Use the get-vehicles action first if you need to check whether a vehicle already exists.

get_vehicle.name: get_vehicle
get_vehicle.description: Retrieve information of a specific vehicle.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a single vehicle by its ID. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already know the vehicle ID; to list all vehicles use the get-vehicles action.

delete_vehicle.name: delete_vehicle
delete_vehicle.description: Delete a vehicle by its ID.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a vehicle by its ID. Destructive and not safely repeatable: a repeat call fails once the vehicle is gone, so confirm the ID first.

get_visits.name: get_visits
get_visits.description: Retrieve all registered visits. Can be filtered by planned visit date.

planned_date.description: Filter visits by planned date (YYYY-MM-DD format).

aiMetadata.description: List registered visits filtered by planned date. Read-only and idempotent; use to enumerate the visits scheduled for a day. For a single visit by ID use the get-visit or get-visit-detail action instead.

create_visits.name: create_visits
create_visits.description: Create visits. Multiple visits can be created in a single request.

visits.description: Array of visit objects to create.

title.description: String to identify the delivery. Usually company or person's name.

address.description: Address text. Best practice is to use Googlemaps format.

planned_date.description: Date when the visit will be delivered. (YYYY-MM-DD)

load.description: Space of the truck that visit uses.

load_2.description: Space of the truck that visit uses.

load_3.description: Space of the truck that visit uses.

window_start.description: Initial Hour when the visit can be visit (HH:MM:SS).

window_end.description: Final Hour when the visit can be visit (HH:MM:SS).

window_start_2.description: Initial Hour when the visit can be visit (HH:MM:SS).

window_end_2.description: Final Hour when the visit can be visit (HH:MM:SS).

order.description: Visit order when the visit already belongs to a delivery route.

skills_required.description: A list of skills or capabilities required (JSON format [1, 2]).

skills_optional.description: A list of skills or capabilities optionals (JSON format [1, 2]).

contact_name.description: Name of who will receive the delivery.

contact_phone.description: Phone of who will receive the delivery.

contact_email.description: E-mail of who will receive the delivery.

reference.description: Reference or internal identifier of the company. Example: Invoice or order number.

priority_level.description: If the visit is more important than others. It goes from 1 to 5.

visit_type.description: Visit type associated with the visit.

aiMetadata.description: Create one or more delivery visits (stops) in a single batch request, each requiring a title, address, planned date, and load. Not idempotent: re-running creates duplicate visits, so do not retry blindly. To change an existing visit use the update actions instead.

get_visit.name: get_visit
get_visit.description: Retrieve details of a specific visit by ID.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a single visit record by its ID. Read-only and idempotent; use for the basic visit fields. For the richer plan-level breakdown use get-visit-detail instead.

update_visit_partial.name: update_visit_partial
update_visit_partial.description: Partially update fields of an existing visit.

visit_id.description: ID of the visit to update.

title.description: Visit title (if you want to change it).

address.description: Visit address (if you want to change it).

aiMetadata.description: Patch only the supplied fields of an existing visit by ID, leaving other fields untouched. Idempotent for a fixed payload. Prefer this over the complete-update action when changing just a few fields; only visit_id is required.

update_visit.name: update_visit
update_visit.description: Completely update an existing visit with all fields.

visit_id.description: ID of the visit to update.

aiMetadata.description: Fully replace an existing visit (PUT) by ID, requiring title, address, and planned date even for unchanged fields. Idempotent for a fixed payload. Pick this when overwriting the whole visit; use the partial-update action to change only a few fields without resending the rest.

delete_visit.name: delete_visit
delete_visit.description: Delete a visit by its ID.

visit_id.description: ID of the visit to delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a single visit by its ID. Destructive and not safely repeatable: once deleted the visit is gone and a repeat call will fail, so confirm the ID before calling.

add_visit_items.name: add_visit_items
add_visit_items.description: Add items to an existing visit.

visit_id.description: ID of the visit to add items to.

items.description: Array of items to add to the visit.

title.description: Name or description of the item.

load.description: Unit of load that the item occupies.

load_2.description: Second load unit of the item.

load_3.description: Third load unit of the item.

quantity_delivered.description: Delivered quantity of the item (if applicable).

aiMetadata.description: Append one or more line items (products/cargo) to an existing visit identified by visit_id. Not idempotent: each call adds items, so re-running duplicates them. Use only after the visit exists.

get_routes.name: get_routes
get_routes.description: Retrieve the list of existing routes.

aiMetadata.description: List all routes planned for a given date (YYYY-MM-DD), returning each route with its assigned vehicle, driver and stops. Use to review or pick routes for a specific day; for a single known route id use Get Route instead. Read-only and idempotent.

create_route.name: create_route
create_route.description: Create a new route manually by assigning vehicle, driver and date.

plan.description: Plan (execution) ID to associate the route (UUID).

aiMetadata.description: Manually create a route under an existing plan, assigning a vehicle, driver, planned date, estimated time window and start/end locations. Use to build a route by hand rather than via automatic planning; not idempotent, so each call creates another route. Requires the parent plan UUID and the vehicle/driver ids.

get_route.name: get_route
get_route.description: Retrieve details of a specific route.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the full details of one route by its UUID, including assigned vehicle, driver and stops. Use when you already have a route id; to find routes by date use Get Routes instead. Read-only and idempotent.

delete_route.name: delete_route
delete_route.description: Delete a route by its ID.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a single route identified by its UUID. Use to remove an unwanted or mistaken route; destructive and irreversible. Deleting an already-removed route id simply has no further effect.

get_plans.name: get_plans
get_plans.description: Retrieve the list of saved routing plans (executions).

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the saved routing plans (executions) for a given date. Read-only and idempotent; the date is required, so use it to inspect what plans exist for a specific day.

create_plan.name: create_plan
create_plan.description: Create an empty plan (execution) without routes (reserve a planning day).

aiMetadata.description: Create a new empty routing plan (execution) for a given date range, reserving a planning day before routes are added. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate plan, so guard against duplicate plans for the same date.

get_plan_vehicles.name: get_plan_vehicles
get_plan_vehicles.displayName: Get vehicles with routes on date
get_plan_vehicles.description: Returns the vehicles that have planned routes on the indicated date.

aiMetadata.description: Look up which vehicles have planned routes on a specific date. Read-only and idempotent; use when you need the routed-vehicle subset for a day rather than the full plan or the entire vehicle fleet.

get_visit_detail.name: get_visit_detail
get_visit_detail.description: Get detailed information about a specific visit.

visit_id.description: ID of the visit to get details for.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the extended detail view of one visit by ID. Read-only and idempotent; pick this over get-visit when you need the fuller plan-level detail payload rather than the basic visit record.

get_drivers.name: get_drivers
get_drivers.description: Retrieve the list of drivers registered in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List all drivers/users registered in the account. Read-only and idempotent; takes no input. Use to discover user IDs before fetching, updating, or assigning a specific driver.

create_users.name: create_users
create_users.description: Create new user/driver in the account.

is_admin.description: Whether the user is an administrator.

is_driver.description: Whether the user is a driver.

is_router_jr.description: Whether the user is a router junior.

is_router.description: Whether the user is a router.

is_monitor.description: Whether the user is a monitor.

is_coordinator.description: Whether the user is a coordinator.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new user/driver, requiring username, password, and the is_driver flag. Not idempotent: each call creates another account, so do not retry blindly. To change an existing user use the update-user action.

get_user.name: get_user
get_user.description: Retrieve information of a specific user by ID.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a single user/driver by its ID. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already know the user ID; to list all drivers use the get-drivers action.

update_user.name: update_user
update_user.description: Update information of an existing user.

is_admin.description: Whether the user is an administrator.

is_driver.description: Whether the user is a driver.

is_router_jr.description: Whether the user is a router junior.

is_router.description: Whether the user is a router.

is_monitor.description: Whether the user is a monitor.

is_coordinator.description: Whether the user is a coordinator.

aiMetadata.description: Fully update an existing user/driver (PUT) by ID, requiring username and name along with the user_id. Idempotent for a fixed payload since it overwrites the user record. Use the get-drivers action to find the user_id first.

get_skills.name: get_skills
get_skills.description: Retrieve the list of skills available in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List all driver/vehicle skills defined in the account, returning their ids and names. Use to resolve a valid skill reference before requiring it on visits or assigning it to resources. Read-only and idempotent; takes no inputs.

get_observations.name: get_observations
get_observations.description: Retrieve the list of observations available in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List the route observation types defined in the account, returning their ids and labels. Use to resolve a valid observation reference before applying it to a route or visit. Read-only and idempotent; takes no inputs.

get_tags.name: get_tags
get_tags.description: Retrieve the list of tags available in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List all route tags defined in the account, returning their ids and names. Use to resolve a valid tag reference before applying tags to routes or visits. Read-only and idempotent; takes no inputs.

get_zones.name: get_zones
get_zones.description: Retrieve the list of zones available in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List all geographic zones defined in the account, returning their ids and names. Use to resolve a zone reference before assigning it to clients or visits. Read-only and idempotent; takes no inputs.

get_fleets.name: get_fleets
get_fleets.description: Retrieve the list of fleets available in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List all fleets configured in the account, returning their ids and names. Use to resolve a valid fleet reference before grouping vehicles or filtering planning by fleet. Read-only and idempotent; takes no inputs.

get_sellers.name: get_sellers
get_sellers.description: Retrieve the list of sellers available in the account.

aiMetadata.description: List all sellers configured in the account, returning their ids and names. Use to resolve a seller reference before tagging clients or visits with one. Read-only and idempotent; takes no inputs.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Your SimpliRoute API token. You can find this in your SimpliRoute account settings under API section.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Your SimpliRoute API token. You can find this in your SimpliRoute account settings under API section.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

fr.Your SimpliRoute API token. You can find: Votre jeton API SimpliRoute. Vous pouvez le trouver dans les paramètres de votre compte SimpliRoute dans la section API.
fr.Get vehicles with routes on date: Obtenez des véhicules avec des routes à la date
fr.Get Visit Detail: Obtenir les détails de la visite
fr.Returns account information of the authe: Renvoie les informations du compte de l'utilisateur authentifié via le jeton API.
fr.Retrieves the list of clients associated: Récupère la liste des clients associés au compte. Peut filtrer par clé client.
fr.Create one or multiple new clients in th: Créer un ou plusieurs nouveaux clients dans le compte.
fr.Delete multiple clients in a single call: Supprimer plusieurs clients dans un seul appel.
fr.Create a new custom attribute for client: Créer un nouvel attribut personnalisé pour les clients.
fr.Retrieve the list of vehicles registered: Récupérez la liste des véhicules immatriculés dans le compte.
Inscrire un nouveau véhicule dans le compte.
fr.Retrieve information of a specific vehic: Récupérer les informations d'un véhicule spécifique.
Supprimer un véhicule par son ID.
